specification: Epic: Widget names are case- and whitespace-insensitive: the store keeps each name normalised (trimmed, lower-case), and a client can always look a widget up by the name it created it with, in any case or spacing. Widgets record their creation time.

findings.Message: FindByName compares the raw input ordinally without normalising it, so a client that created "Alpha" (stored as "alpha") gets null when looking it up by "Alpha", violating the ticket's requirement that lookup works in any case or spacing.

findings.Snippet:
app.MapGet("/widgets/by-name/{name}", (string name, WidgetStore store) =>
    store.FindByName(name) is { } widget ? Results.Ok(widget) : Results.NotFound());
findings.Message: The by-name route passes the raw path value straight to FindByName without trimming or lower-casing, so lookups with different case or surrounding whitespace return 404 instead of the widget.
